items.title: Submit proof that the loan is used for the home (invoice or signed order)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie den Nachweis binnen 10 Arbeitstagen nach dem Briefdatum ein.
items.computation: Letter is dated Saturday 21.11.2026. The period is set by the company itself (‘nach dem Briefdatum’, after the letter date), so following the standard rule of §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the triggering event (21.11.) is not counted and the period starts the next day, Sunday 22.11.2026. Only 'Arbeitstage' (Mon–Fri, excluding statutory holidays) are counted: Mon 23.11=1, Tue 24.11=2, Wed 25.11=3, Thu 26.11=4, Fri 27.11=5 (weekend 28.-29.11 skipped), Mon 30.11=6, Tue 01.12=7, Wed 02.12=8, Thu 03.12=9, Fri 04.12=10. No NRW public holiday falls in this window, so the 10th working day, Friday 04.12.2026, is the last day the proof must be received.
